Frontend E2E in real browser: /plan/{token} renders with 'Download PDF' button clearly visible on dark navy hero (not blank), 'View your proposal' CTA navigates to /plan/{token}/proposal, proposal shows A$2,310.00 initial total, ticking prop-addon-interview-for-success updates total to A$4,620.00, Terms & Conditions (CS-1.0) expandable details element, Step 1 agree → Step 2 details (prefilled with full_name & email) → Step 3 type-to-sign → prop-sign-btn succeeds and jumps to Step 4 'Pay A$2,310.00'. Stripe redirect worked (hosted checkout), filled card 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12/34 / 123 / US 94103 (had to uncheck 'Save my information for faster checkout' because Link enrolment requires a phone number which Playwright left blank), Pay submitted → redirected to /plan/{token}?paid=cs_test_... and the plan page immediately showed the 'You're a client 🎉' pill (data-testid=plan-paid). DB verification of conversion: prospect.status='paid', client_id='befb...', coaching_clients row inserted (first/last/email/phone/active), 1 client_engagements row for service_package_key='career-coaching-essentials', orders row status='paid' total=231000 currency aud source='cdp' with correct stripe_session_id. ui_bugs.issue: CDP modal opens behind/on top of the prospect detail modal; both modals use the same z-50 backdrop in AdminLayout.Modal so the prospect detail modal's backdrop intercepts pointer events on the CDP modal body. In headed browser Playwright, clicking cdp-draft or cdp-approve requires force=True, and even then the content rendered unreliably. Winnie's real-world click-through works because of focus timing but UX is confusing and buttons feel 'frozen'.
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid='cdp-modal'] vs the parent prospect detail modal backdrop

ui_bugs.issue: On revisiting /plan/{token}/proposal after a successful accept, UI resets to Step 1 (agree) because `step` is a local useState(1) and ignores server-side `accepted: true`. User has to re-agree + re-fill details + re-sign to reach the Pay button. Should initialise step=4 when `data.accepted === true`.

issues: Narrative sections currently contain many '[TO CONFIRM]' placeholders from Claude when notes are sparse — expected content gap, but worth guard-railing: refuse approve when > N placeholders? Not a bug, flag for Winnie.
Package cards still show '[DESCRIPTION TO COME]' and '[INCLUSIONS TO COME]' placeholder copy on the public proposal page — same content gap flagged in F1, still unfilled.

action_items: Fix modal z-index/stacking: when opening the CDP modal from a prospect detail modal, either close the parent modal first or stack the CDP modal above the parent's backdrop (bump z-index to z-[60] and ensure its backdrop also sits above the parent).
Proposal.jsx: initialise step based on `data.accepted` (set step=4 if accepted) so clients who come back via WeChat link don't have to re-sign the T&Cs again just to pay.

(Optional UX) Stripe checkout: unchecking 'Save my information for faster checkout' by default or passing `payment_method_options={'link': 'never'}` would avoid the phone-number validation friction when non-US cards are used.
critical_code_review_comments: cdp.py:_quote iterates `notes.packages` by key; service_packages collection uses hyphenated keys (career-coaching-essentials, interview-for-success). Any mismatch (e.g., frontend using snake_case) silently returns `lines: []` and total 0, which bubbles up as 'Nothing to pay' at checkout. Add a 400 with explanatory message when no included lines exist.

cdp.py:/plan/{token}/accept overwrites prospect first_name from body.full_name.split(' ')[0] every time; if a client re-signs with a different name typo the stored first_name is clobbered. Consider only setting first_name on first accept.

cdp.py:/plan/{token}/confirm — client gets GET /confirm?session_id but the backend never verifies that `session.metadata.prospect_id` matches the token's prospect. Anyone with a token could pass another prospect's completed session_id and (incorrectly) trigger /confirm. _convert is only safe because the function pulls data from the prospect, not the session, but still — add a metadata check for defence in depth.

cdp.py:_convert — no idempotency key. If the client reloads /plan/{token}?paid=... twice before status is persisted, two coaching_clients + two engagements + two orders could be created. Status check at top is best-effort. Wrap in a MongoDB atomic update like `prospects.find_one_and_update({id, status:{$ne:'paid'}}, {$set:{status:'converting'}})` before creating downstream rows.

AdminCDP.jsx: `draft` auto-saves notes but ignores save failures (not awaited inside try); on API error the user sees 'Draft could not generate' but notes may have been dropped by Pydantic validation. Separate the two awaits.
Proposal.jsx: `pay` sets busy=true but on failure only resets busy if error caught — if window.location.href assignment is blocked (popup/CSP) the button stays stuck in 'Redirecting…' state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (full Stripe payment + conversion verified; admin CDP modal has stacking bug but core functionality works with force-click)
